Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! The players are already out in the middle. Tamim Iqbal and Litton Das are the two openers for Bangladesh. Sam Curran to start proceedings with the ball. Here we go...
... THE RUN CHASE ...

Right then, England have posted a huge total on the board with some excellent individual batting performances and they will be confident enough to defend this. Bangladesh, on the other hand will need to build some partnerships in the middle and not force anything as the wicket looks good to bat on. It will be an interesting battle between bat and ball. Will the hosts gun this down and level the series? Or will England prove to be too much for them? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the second essay.

Tamim Iqbal asked England to bat first which was a bit surprising as this wicket looked like a batting deck. Bangladesh found that out the hard way as Jason Roy smashed them left, right and centre. Their spinners were also not able to pick up wickets in the middle and leaked runs on a regular basis. They were not able to break the partnerships which costed them a lot, and this is exactly what they will need if they are to chase this down. Taskin Ahmed was their best bowler picking up three wickets while Mushfiqur Rahim picked up a couple of scalps. Shakib Al Hasan and Taijul Islam contributed with one each. Now, their batters have a huge task on their hands if they want to level the series.

England would be really happy with their batting performance, and this innings shows how good their depth in batting actually is. They got off to a steady start, but they lost Philip Salt quite early, and Dawid Malan could not make any impact as well as James Vince. Jason Roy looked good from the beginning and took matters into his own hands. He absolutely bludgeoned the Bangladeshi bowlers all over the park and scored a fine hundred as well. He and Jos Buttler added 109 runs together before Roy holed out at 132. After that, Buttler started to take on the bowlers, and he too got his fifty in no time, but he was dismissed by a stunning catch from Mehidy Hasan on 76. In the end, with the help of a quick-fire 42 from Moeen Ali, and some power hitting from Sam Curran, they managed to get over the 325-run mark with ease. The onus will be on their bowlers to finish the job and seal the series.

A smashing end of the innings for England! Sam Curran showed some clean hitting while the base was already formed by the brilliant century from Jason Roy. They will be the happier side going into the break and will feel that they already have one hand on the trophy.

England lose half their side now!

OUT! LBW! Shakib Al Hasan gets the big fish, Jason Roy! He gets out playing his go-to shot this time and Bangladesh players are happy to see the back of him. This is floated, full and on middle, Jason Roy goes down and tries to sweep it, but misses and gets hit on the pads right in front of the stumps. There is a huge appeal for LBW, and up goes the finger. A brilliant innings from Roy finally comes to an end.

So close! This is on a good length and on off, shaping in, Jason Roy gets cut in half and misses as the ball just misses the stumps.

Back of a length but outside off, way outside off, Jason Roy leaves it alone. Wided.

FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries for Roy! Taskin Ahmed serves this touch fuller and on middle, Jason Roy drills it past the bowler, he did not middle it but the outfield is quick and it races to fence for four more runs.

A single to end the over as this full delivery is reverse-swept towards sweeper covers. 12 runs off the over!
FOUR! Jason Roy is taking on Shakib here! This is short again and outside off, Jason Roy frees his arms and cuts it past the diving cover fielder for another boundary.
Quicker, short and on leg, Jason Roy knocks it towards the left of short mid-wicket.
FOUR! Nice shot! This is floated, full and on middle, Jason Roy goes down and slog-sweeps it towards the deep mid-wicket fence for a boudnary.
Short and on off, Jos Buttler moves back and punches it through covers for a single.
Tossed up, full and on off, Jos Buttler drives it firmly wide of short covers where the fielder does well to get a hand to it and parries it towards long off. Two runs taken!

As they usually say you double the score at the end of over 30 more often than not in the ODI's, If that is the case today then Bangladesh would find themselves in real trouble in their own backyard. Jason Roy has looked like he means business today and has converted a good start into a century. It is now that we will see an ultra-aggressive Roy smashing the bowlers all around the park it seems.

Drinks have been taken at the stroke of the 2nd wicket. England has had a good start in this game so far. Jason Roy has looked at ease and looks like have shifted a gear or two in the last few overs. The wicket of Dawid Malan will surely tighten things in the middle for Bangladesh. James Vince walks out in the middle to join Jason Roy.

OUT! PLUMB IN FRONT! Mehidy Hasan strikes! Dawid Malan goes back to the hut for a low score in this game. Mehidy Hasan bowls this flatter and quicker, on middle and leg, grips and turns away a bit, Dawid Malan is stuck on the crease and tries to fend it away, but plays down the wrong line and gets rapped on his pads right in front of the stumps. Bangladesh spinners have done well to keep the runs in check, but Jason Roy is looking to break the shackles now.
FIFTY FOR ROY! This has been an excellent knock after struggling initially. This is tossed up, full and on off, Jason Roy uses his feet and chips it wide of sweeper covers for a brace.
Floated, full and on middle, Dawid Malan drills it towards long on for a single.

FIVE WIDES! This is poor from Taijul Islam! He darts this one full and around leg, Dawid Malan misses his flick, and the keeper fails to stop it as well and the ball races towards the fine leg fence for a boundary.
FOUR! Up and over! Mustafizur Rahman bowls another slower delivery, full and on off, Jason Roy waits for it this time and lifts it way over mid off for a boundary.
Back of a length and outside off, Dawid Malan cuts it towards deep point for a run.
Goes slower again, on a length and around off, Jason Roy guides it through point for a single.
Pulls his length back a bit, on middle, Jason Roy pushes it back to the bowler.
A slower delivery now, full and on off, Jason Roy looks to drive, but gets an outside edge along the ground towards the keeper where Mushfiqur Rahim dives to his right to stop it.
On a length and on middle, Jason Roy knocks it towards mid on.
Fires this one full and on middle, Dawid Malan tucks it towards short mid-wicket.
Flatter, full and on leg, Dawid Malan advances down the track to clip it away, but gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a couple of runs.
Flatter, full and on off, Jason Roy drives it towards long off for a single.
Flighted and around off, Jason Roy uses his feet to loft it away, but gets an outside edge on the bounce towards short third man.
Tossed up, full and on middle, Jason Roy looks to push it away, but gets an inside edge onto his pads.

FOUR! Good execution! This is tossed up around leg, Jason Roy gets into postion to reverse sweep, and has to drag it from the leg side. He does well to time that towards the deep point fence for a boundary.
An off-cutter now, on a length and on middle, turning in, Dawid Malan looks to play at it, but is a bit early into his shot and misses to get hit high on his body.
BEATEN! Mustafizur Rahman serves this full and around off, nips away bit, Dawid Malan goes for the drive on the up, but gets beaten on the outside edge.
On a length and around leg, Jason Roy misses his flick as the ball goes off his pads towards fine leg. A leg bye is taken.
Another short delivery outside off, Jason Roy slaps it with no timing, but it just flies wide and over mid off. Two runs taken!
Short and around off, Dawid Malan goes for the pull, but gets a bottom edge onto the pitch and to the leg side. They cross.
Full and on middle, Jason Roy clips it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Mustafizur Rahman continues.
Goes fuller this time, on off, Jason Roy drives it towards sweeper covers for one.
Taskin Ahmed lands this short again and on middle, Dawid Malan pulls it this time towards deep square leg for a run.
Short and on middle, Jason Roy mistimes his pull shot towards deep square leg for a single.
Back of a length and around off, Jason Roy cuts it straight to point.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Taskin Ahmed serves this touch fuller and around middle, Jason Roy stays there and shows the full face of the bat to drive it towards the long on fence for a boundary.

This is on a good length, outside off, Jason Roy moves across to defend, but misses and gets hit on the pads as the ball loops up towards backward point. Taskin Ahmed appeals for it, almost begs for it, but turned down.
POWERPLAY 2! With 10 overs completed, Bangladesh will be allowed to place four fielders at the boundary line till the 40th over.
Full and around off, driven straight to cover. At the end of the first Powerplay, England are 40/1!
Misfield! Pitched up around off, Dawid Malan gets on the front foot and drives it crisply but straight to cover-point where the fielder misfields and allows the batters to pick up a couple of runs.
Short and outside off, this is dabbed away off the back foot toward deep backward point for one more.
A tad shorter and outside off, this is slashed away toward wide third man for a single.
Nicely bowled! On a good length again, pace on this time and angling in from around off. Dawid Malan looks to block but is beaten on the outside edge.

Mustafizur Rahman comes into the attack and starts off with a cutter. This is on a good length and outside off, Malan looks to play it on the off side but the ball hits the toe end and gets miscued onto the leg side.
Full and on off stump, Dawid Malan bunts it out in front of mid off and scampers through for a quick single.
Hard length again, on a closer line around off, Roy hangs back and dabs it down to third man for one.
Pitches this one up around off stump, Roy keeps it out on the off side.
Back of a length around off, Jason Roy lets it through to the keeper.
Oh, that has taken off! On a hard length around off, Roy looks to cut but the ball shoots up off the deck and Roy is left bamboozled.
EDGED AND FOUR! Good length around the top of off, Jason Roy pushes at it with hard hands and gets an inside edge that goes past the leg stump and into the fine leg fence.
Flighted delivery, on off stump, Roy knocks it down to long off for a run.
Quicker and a bit short around off, tapped away onto the off side.
Fires one in on the leg stump, Roy manages to keep it out.
FOUR! Slapped away! A touch short and outside off, Jason Roy goes on the back foot and cuts it hard through the cover region for a boundary.
Floats this one up full and on middle and leg, Roy pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter and around middle, kept out off the back foot.
Bangs it in short around leg stump, trying to attack the body. Malan awkwardly gets out of the way and no wide is called either.
This is pitched up around off, Malan leans forward and pushes it toward cover.

Top delivery! Pitches it a bit further up around off stump at 141.3 clicks and angles it across the left-hander. Dawid Malan looks to get on the front foot and defend but the ball just zips past the outside edge.
Dawid Malan, the centurion from the last game, walks out to the middle at number 3.

OUT! TAKEN! Excellent bowling and an even better take in the slips! Taskin Ahmed steams in and bowls this one on a good length at 141 clicks. The ball is angled in from outside off and Philip Salt gets on the back foot as he tries to cut it really late. Salt does so with hard hands and gets an outside edge. The ball goes quickly to first slip and Najmul Hossain Shanto takes a sharp catch as the ball was also dying on him. The umpires go upstairs to check for a fair catch and the soft signal is out. The replays show that Shanto has his fingers underneath and Salt has to walk back.
Commentary.Howout: c Najmul Hossain Shanto b Taskin Ahmed

Commentary.Commentary: Pitched up on off stump, Salt drives it straight to mid off.
Goes wide of the crease and angles it in on a good length from outside off. Jason Roy edges it down to third man and picks up a single.

Did that carry? Doesn't look like it. Tossed up on the pads and Jason Roy pushes at it. The ball sticks in the surface and Roy ends up pushing it uppishly just in front of mid-wicket. The fielder there makes a half stop and they get a single.
Floated up around off, pushed out on the off side.
A tad short around off, this is tapped away in front of cover.

An absolute ripper! Shakib Al Hasan cannot believe how he hasn't got a wicket there. Drifts this one in beautifully onto middle and draws Jason Roy forward. The ball grips and turns away sharply going past the outside edge and missing the off stump by milimeters.
Chipped! Flights this one up around off stump, Jason Roy leans forward and lofts it over the extra cover region for a couple of runs.
This is short and wide outside off, Philip Salt rocks back and slaps it away well in front of square on the off side for a single.
Shakib Al Hasan (2-0-7-0) changes ends now.

Bowls this one back of a length and outside the off pole. Jason Roy gets up on his toes and fends the ball towards point. An outstanding over from Taskin Ahmed with only the boundary coming off the outside edge.
Goes full this time and outside the off stump. Jason Roy looks to push at this but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Gets this one to nip back in sharply from a good length and from outside the off stump. Jason Roy shuffles across the stumps and gets hit high on the pads as he looks to work this away. There is a massive appeal from the bowler but the umpire remains unmoved. They do not opt for a review.

FOUR! A streaky boundary from Jason Roy and Taskin Ahmed will feel hard done here! This is bowled on a good length and outside the off stump. Jason Roy looks to hit through the line but gets an outside edge that flies past the first slip fielder for four runs to third man.
Bowls this one a touch fuller and attacks the off stump. Jason Roy blocks this solidly towards mid on.
Taskin Ahmed begins with a good length delivery bowled outside the off pole. Jason Roy is watchful as he shoulders his arms to this one.
Gets this full as well and outside the off pole. Jason Roy clips this to the right of mid on and takes one to retain strike.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside off. Jason Roy opts to leave this one alone.

This is served wide outside off on a fuller length. Jason Roy reaches for it and gets bat on the ball. The ball is miscued into the air but clears the infield and they take two runs as it goes towards deep cover-point.
Goes full once again and outside off. Philip Salt shimmies down the wicket and strokes this towards long off for a run.
Tosses this one full and outside off. Philip Salt knocks this straight to cover.
BEATEN! Taijul Islam flights this full and outside off. Philip Salt looks to go hard at the ball but misses as there is some vicious turn away from the bat.
Short once again and angled in from outside off. Jason Roy rocks back and cuts hard but finds the short third man fielder.
Loops this one full and outside off. Philip Salt pushes this to long off and takes a single.
Slightly short this time and just outside off. Philip Salt punches this straight to the point fielder off the back foot.
Continues to toss this one full and outside off. Philip Salt defends this towards cover.
Goes full once again and outside off. Philip Salt hits this firmly to extra cover.
Shakib Al Hasan floats this one full and outside off. Jason Roy eases this down to long off for one.
Fires this one full and outside off. Jason Roy taps this towards short third man and takes a quick single.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside off. Jason Roy blocks this to the cover fielder.
Gets sharp turn as he flights this one full and outside off. Jason Roy leaves this one alone.
Goes full this time and outside the off stump. Jason Roy dabs this towards cover.
This is short as well and outside off. Jason Roy knocks this towards mid on.

FOUR! A poor delivery to start off by Taijul Islam and it gets the treatment! He bowls this short and outside off. Jason Roy gets back in the crease and the ball sits up nicely for him to pull this towards deep mid-wicket for four runs.
Taijul Islam to operate from the other end.
Another loopy delivery bowled full and outside the off stump. Philip Salt gets well forward and dabs this solidly towards cover. 5 runs from the first over.
Tosses this one full and outside the off pole. Philip Salt defends this towards the point fielder.

FOUR! Philip Salt is off the mark in style! Shakib Al Hasan bowls this one slightly short and angles this into the stumps. Philip Salt goes deep in the crease and punches this towards deep cover-point for four runs.
Loopy delivery bowled full and outside the off stump. Philip Salt blocks this back towards the bowler.
Bowls this slightly short and in line with the stumps. Philip Salt rocks back and tucks this towards short fine leg.
Shakib Al Hasan begins with a floated delivery bowled full and outside the off stump. Jason Roy pushes this watchfully towards long off for a single to open his account.

We are all set to begin! The umpires are out in the middle and so are the players of Bangladesh. It will be Jason Roy and Philip Salt to open the innings for England. Shakib Al Hasan has been handed the new ball and will get proceedings underway. Let's play...

PITCH REPORT - Dominic Cork is pitchside. He says that the conditions are a bit warmer from the first game and there's a bit of breeze as well. Reckons that there will be a bit more bounce and there is grass but it has been rolled in. Says that there's no a lot difference in batting first or second here.

Jos Buttler, the English skipper says that they were looking to bat first and the wicket looks a bit tacky. Adds that Dawid Malan played an outstanding inning last time around and they have plenty of areas to improve upon in this game. Mentions that they have to assess the conditions and adjust quickly and reckons that it is a tough challenge playing against Bangladesh at home. Informs that they have made a couple of changes to the side with Sam Curran and Saqib Mahmood coming in.

Tamim Iqbal the captain of Bangladesh says that they want to ball first today as he claims the wicket looks a bit soft and tacky. Claims that it is a fantastic ground for them and they were good in the last game even though the batters failed, the bowling and fielding were really good. Adds that they hope to bat well in this game and do the same things on the field. Mentions that they had a long chat about what they need to do but the main thing is to execute the plans. Informs that they are unchanged.

Bangladesh (Unchanged Playing XI) - Tamim Iqbal (C), Litton Das, Najmul Hossain Shanto, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Shakib Al Hasan, Mahmudullah, Afif Hossain, Mehidy Hasan, Taskin Ahmed, Mustafizur Rahman, Taijul Islam.

England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Philip Salt, Dawid Malan, James Vince, Jos Buttler (C/WK), Will Jacks, Moeen Ali, Sam Curran (In place of Chris Woakes), Adil Rashid, Saqib Mahmood (In place of Jofra Archer), Mark Wood.
TOSS - The captains are out in the middle. The coin is flipped into the air and lands in favor of Bangladesh. They have elected to BOWL first.

The visitors had a great time with the ball last time around having used six bowlers and all of them were in the wickets as they did a great job restricting the opponents to an under-par total. However, the star-studded top-order had an unlikely collapse and they needed a well-composed unbeaten century from Dawid Malan to register a win. They will want to take the winning momentum into this game but more importantly, they will be keen on a better performance. Will they take an unassailable lead in the series? Or will the hosts bring it back on level terms? We will find out soon. Stay tuned for the toss and team updates.

Bangladesh were poor with the bat in the last fixture with several of their batters getting decent starts but not converting them to big scores. They have several experienced heads in their batting order and playing in home conditions, they would be eager to put their best foot forward. The spinners ruled the roost and claimed the bulk of the wickets and they will also come into play in this game. The pace bowling attack also looked good but they were underused on this pitch. They will have to put on a complete performance if they are to beat the reigning champions of the world and get the crowd well behind them going into the final game.

Hello, and a warm welcome, ladies and gentlemen to our coverage of the 2nd ODI in the three-match series between Bangladesh and England at the Sher-E-Bangla National Cricket Stadium in Dhaka with the previous game also played at the same venue. The game was a low-scoring thriller and in the end, the visitors got over the line with three wickets in hand and 8 balls to spare. They have a good opportunity to seal the series in this game but the hosts are certain to put up a fight and continue their good run in the 50-over format by leveling the series.
